title: SpanGroundedFieldMetaSchema
description: Foundational meta-schema for span-grounded JSON field extraction in Bangla transactional documents.

SourceSpan.description: Character-level span grounding into raw OCR text

start.description: 0-indexed character start position in raw OCR text

end.description: 0-indexed character end position (exclusive) in raw OCR text

text.description: Verbatim substring extracted from OCR text at slice [start:end]

value.description: Normalized field value, or null if absent/unreadable
Normalized numeric value in standard Western float/integer, or null if absent
